sameNetwork: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi or wired network.
sendHelp: Create an invitation to pair with another device.
receiveHelp: Scan a QR code or paste an invitation link.
inviteHelp: On the other device, open the link or scan this QR code. Keep this page open.
replyHelp: On the first device, scan this QR code using the scanner on the invitation screen or paste the reply code there.
chooseFile: Choose a file or drop it here
textPlaceholder: Paste a link, a note, or any plain text.
saveBeforeNext: Save a received file before the next file replaces it.
fileTooLarge: Choose a file up to 128 MiB.
textTooLarge: Send up to 1 MiB of text at a time.
badInvite: This invitation link is invalid. Ask the other device for a new one.
badReply: This reply code is invalid. Copy or scan it again.
cameraError: Could not use the camera. You can paste the link or code instead.
connectionError: The connection ended or could not be established. Check that both devices are on the same network, then pair again.
transferError: The transfer was interrupted. Pair again to retry.
unsupported: This browser cannot create a direct connection. Try a current version of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
